question: What percentage of orders have a discount greater than 20%?
notes: Discovered issue (2026-08-09): the agent's SQL sometimes divides a row-count of discount>0.20 line items by COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), mixing granularities, reporting 28.18% instead of the correct 20.43% (share of DISTINCT orders with at least one qualifying line item, matching COUNT(DISTINCT IF(discount>0.20, order_id, NULL))/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)). Intermittent -- the model doesn't reliably write the same SQL for this question across runs, so this case flips between PASS and FAIL.

notes: Discovered issue (2026-08-09): 'top 10 by sales' should mean the intersection of {overall top-10-by-sales} and {negative profit} (4 products, per the benchmark's own RANK()<=10 AND profit<0 query). Intermittent -- the model doesn't reliably write the same SQL for this question across runs, so this case flips between PASS and FAIL.
